text:
Hello again arrivals crew,
The lounge host sent an update on radio checks

Thanks for staying steady with the handoff work today. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has had a busy stretch, and I want to thank everyone for keeping the tone calm and the guidance clear for each traveler and pet pair. Please continue to greet each arrival with patience, check documents with care, and keep the waiting area relaxed for families who are already feeling pressure from the trip.

For the current arrivals flow, use the usual escalation path if anything feels uncertain and keep your notes brief and accurate. <<FACT F107>> Keep the communication line open with the baggage side and let the front team know early if a carrier needs extra support. If you are helping with a transfer, remember to stay with the handoff until the next staff member has confirmed the details. <<FACT F100>> That extra attention has made a real difference for the animals, especially when a pet arrives nervous or tired.

Please also keep water available, watch for signs of stress, and remind guests that we are here to help them through each step. If a traveler seems overwhelmed, slow the pace, speak gently, and bring in another teammate when needed so no one has to manage a difficult situation alone. Our goal remains the same: to make the process smooth, safe, and reassuring for both guests and animals. Thank you for your steady work and for treating every arrival with care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
